compos.text: Split almost any online purchaseinto easy monthly payments with anAffirm virtual card

compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is promoting a service that allows users to split their online purchases into easy monthly payments using an Affirm virtual card. The screen features logos of popular retailers (Amazon and Best Buy), an illustration of a credit card, and a brief description of the service. At the bottom, there is a "Get Started" button for users to begin using the service.

reason: using this button to jump the hints and enter the login page.
